tools.name: list_all_terms
tools.description: List every term of the Dictionary of Applied Machine Learning (name and key).

tools.name: lookup_term
tools.description: Full dictionary entry (abstract, definition, cross-references) for a term, by key or name.

tools.name: search_terms
tools.description: Search term names and definitions for a keyword or phrase; returns the best matches.

tools.name: get_related_terms
tools.description: The terms a given entry cross-references (its See-also list), with their abstracts.

tools.name: list_learning_paths
tools.description: The author's curated reading orders through the dictionary: one per topic (how ChatGPT works, AI foundations, explainable and trustworthy AI, mathematics of AI, ...), each with its audience and its terms in the order to read them. Use when someone asks what to learn, read, or teach about a topic, or

tools.name: get_learning_path
tools.description: One reading order with the abstract of every term in it. Give `topic` (a path id or words from its title or audience), or `terms` (an explicit list of term keys or names, kept in the given order) — the form a selection on alexjung.at/baukasten/ takes.
